blurb: Aspire Kinetic Arts provides dance classes for ages from babies to teens and adults, including ballet, jazz, tap, contemporary, and fitness classes. They also offer studio rentals with different spaces suitable for various dance shoe types and activities. Classes follow a dress code and have policies regarding punctuality, safety, and weather-related closures.
extraNote: Tardiness over 10 minutes may result in not being allowed to participate · If Seattle Public Schools are closed for inclement weather, Aspire will be closed and classes cancelled · All tuition is non-refundable except with doctor's note or class cancellation due to low enrollment · $25 registration fee per family per semester; $30 for multiple students · Make-up classes may be scheduled for missed classes within the same semester by emailing office · Aspire's New home - just 5 minutes from previous location at 12544 27th Ave NE
